## History

Fred Wright emerged as [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's love interest when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovered the couple professing their love for one another in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. Shortly after, [Diana](../character/diana.md) announced her formal engagement to Fred. In time, Fred and [Diana](../character/diana.md) were married in a ceremony at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Following their wedding, the couple welcomed their first baby together.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), +264 more_

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di--fred-wright.md)

Fred courted [Di](../character/di.md) starting in Volume 2, and their romance culminated in marriage by Volume 3. Following a formal wedding ceremony, the couple drove away together to settle into their new home.

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony and drove away together to their new home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fred-wright.md)

Fred and Diana's relationship grew from a romantic courtship to a formal engagement after they professed their love for one another in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. Though their closeness led to assertions that she shared everything with him as if already her husband, they spent their engagement preparing for a future life together.

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), +3 more</sub>
- presumed Spouse of — tells everything to him (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Proposal P26](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0026), [v3 ch.Atonement” P20](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0020), [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), +1 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a cooperative, friendly relationship through their mutual participation in local community efforts. They served alongside each other as canvassing partners for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), working together on the organization's various projects and meetings.

- Comrade of — canvassing partners  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)</sub>
